facts.content: Primitive types have specific byte sizes and ranges: byte uses 1 byte and stores values from -128 to 127; short uses 2 bytes and stores values up to about 32,000; int uses 4 bytes and stores values up to roughly 2 billion; long uses 8 bytes and stores even larger numbers.
